initiate_KalmanFilter_track: create a KalmanFilter instance and initiate a new track from a bounding box measurement
predict_KalmanFilter_state: run the Kalman filter prediction step to forecast the next state mean and covariance
update_KalmanFilter_correction: run the Kalman filter correction step to update the state with a new measurement and bbox score
project_KalmanFilter_measurement: project the Kalman filter state distribution to measurement space with optional NSA noise scaling
gating_distance_KalmanFilter: compute the squared Mahalanobis gating distance between a track state and multiple measurements
